notes.title: July 15, 2015 : Patch 1.0 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Since the launch of SHOFER Race Driver, we have become aware that some people are currently experiencing issues while playing the game with controllers. Please be assured that we are treating these issues very seriously and are constantly monitoring the forums and our social media pages for your feedback, please keep that information coming.

To help support us with this effort we request you provide clear and detailed descriptions of the issues you are seeing, along with hardware details (for PC users), to aid us in replicating and fixing the issues as quickly as possible.

Alongside this, we have just pushed a new patch to the PC version of the game which contains a number of fixes.

Notes for the PC patch 1.0 are as follows;

    Fixed Controller Mapping : Some keys were on the menu actions conflict with key mapping
    Fixed Reversing button
    Fixed sensitivity of controllers for steering.
